column7:
Are you an Example College student, alumni or staff? 

NOTE: Example Makers Fair is open to Example College students, alumni and staff only.

We check every application against the college directory, so please answer as you are enrolled or employed today.
column8: Please provide your Example College email address. If you are alumni or staff, the address the college gave you is fine, even if you rarely use it.
column9: If you do not have an Example College email, please upload proof that you study or work at Example College (a class timetable, an alumni card or a staff card)
column10:
Discord username

We send table numbers, set-up times and any day-of changes through the fair's Discord server, so we need a username we can find you by. If you do not have an account yet, please make one before the fair; it is free and takes a few minutes, and we will invite you once your application is accepted.

(not your display name)
column12: Link to your shop, website or social account
column13: Have you tabled at a market before? Where?
column14: What do you plan to sell at the fair?
column15:
Please share a link to your portfolio or to photos of the work you will bring to Example Makers Fair. (Instagram, a website or a shared folder all work, as long as it shows recent pieces)

If your portfolio is private, please make it viewable by anyone with the link until applications close, so the review team can see it.
column16:
I confirm that everything I sell at Example Makers Fair is designed and made by me, and that I have the right to sell it.

Resold goods, dropshipped goods and work traced from someone else's art are not allowed. If we find any at your table on the day, we may ask you to pack up and leave.

Fan art is welcome, as long as the drawing itself is yours.
column17:
I confirm that my work follows the fair's content rules.

The fair is held in a public building and families walk through it, so:
- No work that shows graphic violence or sexual content.
- No work that targets a person or a group of people.
- Keep anything for an older audience in a closed binder, and ask for ID before showing it.

If you are not sure whether a piece is allowed, message the team on Discord before the fair and we will tell you.
column18: Which of these clubs do you belong to?
column19:
If you belong to one of these clubs, please upload proof of membership. 

(a screenshot of your membership email or your club card works)
column20:
For each market day, tick every table tier you would accept. Leave a day at None if you cannot come that day.

NOTE: 
- Gold tables are by the main doors, Silver tables line the middle aisle and Bronze tables are along the back wall; each tier costs less than the one before.
- Ticking more tiers makes it more likely we can find you a table.
- We will never place you on a day you left at None, or at a tier you did not tick. [Monday, October 20]

column26:
Would you like a half table or full table?

NOTE:
- A half table is half the width and half the fee of a full table.
- Choose Either if you are happy with whichever we have room for.
- Half tables are shared, so tell us below if you have a partner in mind.
column27:
If you chose half table or either, who would you like to share your table with?

Please give their email address exactly as they wrote it on their own application.

NOTE:
- Both of you must apply separately.
- If you leave this blank, we will pair you with another vendor where we can.
- Your partner must also choose a half table or either.
- We try to honour every pairing but cannot promise it.
